Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The umpires and the players are out in the middle. It will be the usual pairing of Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie to open the innings for Ireland. Fazalhaq Farooqi has the new ball in hand and is raring to go.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then! Ireland need 169 runs to win and take an early 1-0 lead in the five-match T20I series. The chase might seem fairly simple but with Afghanistan's prowess in the spin department, the hosts will have to bat really well to get the job done. Can Ireland get it done? Or will they get suffocated under a web of spin? Find out soon as the chase is up next.

Ireland will mostly be pleased with that bowling effort. They started off well but Andy McBrine was hit for plenty inside the Powerplay. Once Barry McCarthy got rid of Gurbaz, the scoring rate started to slow down. McCarthy then continued his good showing by coming back on to get the wicket of Usman Ghani which allowed the others to pile on the pressure. The spinners, Gareth Delany and George Dockrell were economical and picked up wickets as well. Only that last over from Mark Adair will be something that will bother the hosts as they couldn't end the innings on a high and have a not-so-easy score to chase down.

It was a brisk start from Afghanistan as Rahmanullah Gurbaz took on the bowling attack inside the Powerplay. Gurbaz though fell soon after but Usman Ghani carried on and added 42 runs with Hashmatullah Shahidi. Ghani notched up a half-century but once he got out the batters that followed just didn't seem to give themselves a bit of time and went for the big shots. The visitors kept on losing wickets regularly and couldn't accelerate towards the end but a sensational last-over showing from Ibrahim Zadran has put them in a good position to attack with the ball.

Afghanistan end up with 168 runs, thanks to a blistering finish from Ibrahim Zadran in the final over and they will certainly take that. The wicket looks good and maybe a bit on the slower side but 168 runs look a par score. Ireland will be happy with their effort but would have certainly liked to chase about 15 runs or so less than what they have been asked to get here.
Two more to end the innings and the last over has changed the complexion of the game tottaly. 21 from it! A slower one on middle, this is lofted towards deep mid-wicket for two.
Two more! He keeps strike! A full toss on middle, this is hit down to long on, not timed that well and hence, two taken.
FOUR! Over the off side. Adair has been taken to the cleaners here! This is full and outside off, Zadran lofts it over covers and bags a boundary.

SIX! BANG! All the way again! The last over is turning the tide into the favor of the visitors! Short again, this is a massive hit. It is hammered over the mid-wicket. Two biggies in a row and now 170 is possible.
SIX! BANG! That has gone a long way! Short and on the body, this is pulled over the fine leg fence for a biggie. Welcome one.

Safe! A single to begin the last over! Singles is something Ireland. Naveen-ul-Haq steps out, this is banged short on the body. Naveen-ul-Haq looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off the leading edge towards mid on for one.
Naveen-ul-Haq is in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT! Barry McCarthy gets the dangerous Rashid Khan! Barry McCarthy sticks to his plan of bowling full and outside off, Rashid Khan moves across and and tries to loft it over covers but cannot get the power and the ball goes in the air. George Dockrell at long off, runs to his left, settles under it and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c George Dockrell b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on off, Ibrahim Zadran drills it with the toe end towards deep point for a run.
Swing and a miss! This is on a hard length and on off, Ibrahim Zadran throws his bat at it but gets beaten all ends up.
Barry McCarthy needs to correct his line a bit. This is full again and outside off, way outside off. It is called a wide.
Fullish one and around off, Ibrahim Zadran this time connects and drills it towards deep point for a brace.

FOUR BYES! This is full and wide of off stump, Ibrahim Zadran moves across to cut at it but misses and it goes through Lorcan Tucker's leg and towards the third man fence for four byes. Afghanistan will surely take this.
Full again and outside off again, Ibrahim Zadran slashes and gets beaten. This time the umpire says that it is a legal delivery.
WIDE! This is full and outsdie off, Ibrahim Zadran lets it go to the keeper. It is called a wide.
Barry McCarthy (3-0-29-2) to bowl the penultimate over of the innings.
A single to end an excellent over from Delany! A really good spell from him too. Shorter and on off, this is guided to point for one.
Another loud appeal but turned down! On the pads, Rashid looks to play the paddle sweep but misses. He gets hit on the pads. A huge appeal but turned down. A run taken.
Shorter and on off, this is guided to point.
On off, this is pushed through mid-wicket for one.
Loud appeal but turned down! On middle, this lands and goes on with the arm. Zadran looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A little too high maybe. A dot nevertheless.
A low full toss, a watchful approach by Rashid first up as he works it through mid-wicket for one.
Rashid Khan is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the man and Josh Little gets the better of Azmatullah Omarzai in the end. Back of a length and well outside off, Omarzai just tries to cut it aerially and over the third man fence. Omarzai gets no power on it and the ball flies down the throat of the man stationed at the third man fence. Curtis Campher takes a simple catch and Afghanistan losing too many wickets here.
Commentary.Howout: c Curtis Campher b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Muscled! Azmatullah Omarzai stays back expecting the short and he gets just what he wanted. This is banged in over middle, Omarzai rides the bounce well and pulls it hard and flat over the square leg fence and straight into the advertising hoarding.
Little takes pace off the ball and bowls it wide of the off stump, Zadran just waits for it and guides it down to third man for a single.
Good length, around off, this is played off the back foot past backward point for a single.
A sharp bumper now, around off, Omarzai looks to uppercut it but is beaten for pace and bounce as well.

EDGED AND FOUR! Josh Little comes from around the wicket and angles it in on a length from well outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai hangs back and has a slash at it. The ball goes off the underedge and into the vacant third man fence.
Josh Little (3-0-21-0) comes back in to finish his spell.
A dot to end! Outstanding stuff! Shorter and outside off, this is cut but to point.
Azmatullah Omarzai is in next for Afghanistan.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man and Ireland are coming back strongly into the game! Three wickets in quick succession and that is the best way to stem the run flow. Nabi is very disappointed with himself. This was there to be hit and he knows it. This is short and on middle, Nabi stays back and pulls but straight to the man at deep mid-wicket. This is turning out to be another excellent over.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b George Dockrell

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
That is a gift of a run! On off, Nabi looks to drop and run but is sent back. The keeper fires in a wide throw to the bowler and it goes down to long on for one.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one more.
Just the one! Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
George Dockrell is brought back into the attack.
Yes, he does! On middle, this is clipped through square leg for a single.
A short one, Zadran pulls it well towards deep square leg for one. Can Barry McCarthy end the over well now?
Good length and on off, this one jags back in. Nabi looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
Ibrahim Zadran is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a huge wicket at this time! Usman Ghani, the well-set batter is out of here. Barry McCarthy's move has worked! We did not feel it was the right one as he has been expensive but he gets the vital breakthrough. Two wickets in quick succession and Ireland now have two new batters at the crease. Just what they would have wanted, heading into the last 5. A slower one on middle, Ghani is early in the whip, it goes off the top edge towards deep mid-wicket. Taken really well by Harry Tector.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one more.
Starts well! Length and on off, it is mistimed towards mid off for one.
The skipper, Mohammad Nabi walks in at number 5.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a huge wicket! Najibullah Zadran can be very dangerous towards the end. Gareth Delany gets a well-deserved wicket. He has been really good with the ball. This is tossed up outside off, it seems to be the googly, Zadran swings, it goes more off the outer half towards point. The fielder, Andy McBrine runs back and takes a good catch. Can Ireland build from here now?
Commentary.Howout: c Andy McBrine b Gareth Delany

Commentary.Commentary: That is brilliant from Andy McBrine! On middle, this is swept towards deep square leg. The fielder there runs to his left and manages to push it back in really well. Saves three for his side.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
SIX! BANG! All the way! That was in the slot! Full and outside off, this is lofted over the long off fence for a biggie. Afghanistan on the charge now.
On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Ghani will feel he missed out there! On the pads, he looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
A single to end! Outside off, a full toss, it is hit through point for one. End of an expensive over from Little.

EDGY FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Ghani throws his bat at it, it flies off the outside edge and goes down to the third man fence. Second boundary in the over and it is not a good comeback for Little so.
Two more and that is fifty for Ghani! Began slowly but has played brilliantly. Can he stay there till the end now? On off, he guides it wide of the fielder at deep point for two.

FOUR! That is not the best of balls! Short and on the body with the fine leg and the square leg in the ring. This is pulled nicely past the latter and into the fence. A welcome boundary for Afghanistan.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to deep square leg for one.
Short and outside off, bowling to his field, making the batter hit to the longer side. This is cut down to point for one.
Josh Little (2-0-8-0) comes back into the attack now.
Darts this one and on middle, a bit short too, Usman Ghani pulls it hard towards the deep square leg fence but the fiedler there does well to cut it out and keeps it down to one.
Floated full and on middle and off, Najibullah Zadran lofts in the air and towards long on for just a single.
Short and outside off, Najibullah Zadran stays back and cuts it towards deep point for a brace.
Loopy delivery and on middle, Usman Ghani skips down the track and tucks it away wide of deep square leg for another run.
Tossed up full and on off, Najibullah Zadran goes for the heave over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge through square leg for a run.
Quicker and flatter on the leg stump,. Usman Ghani whips it away towards deep square leg for one.
Gareth Delany (1-0-7-0) is back on.
Slower again, full and around off, Usman Ghani this time digs it towards mid off and picks up a single.
Slower one, full and outside off, Usman Ghani looks to play at it but gets beaten by lack of pace on it.
Length again and outside off, Usman Ghani looks to slash it away without any footwork but cannot connect.
On a length and outside off, way outside off for the umpire's liking. Wided.
Length delivery and on off, Najibullah Zadran tucks it away through mid-wicket for another single.
WIDE! Adair tries the bouncer, on middle, but bowls it way above head height. Wided.
This is on a good length and around off, Usman Ghani tries to pull but mistimes it towards long on for one.
Short and on middle, Najibullah Zadran gets into position early and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.

A single to end a fruitful over by George Dockrell, just 3 runs and a wicket off it. This is shorter and on leg stump, Najibullah Zadran eases it in front of mid-wicket and gets across for a single. At the halfway mark, Afghanistan are 78/2!
On a length and outside off, this is punched away with soft hands by Ghani through point for a single.

Drinks! Afghanistan started well with Rahmanullah Gurbaz scoring runs qucikly and used the Powerplay well. He gave away his wicket and gace Ireland the chance to squeeze them in and they have done that. Hashmatullah Shahidi was looking good too but he has been sent packing as well. The game is in the balance now and an exciting session awaits us. Also, Najibullah Zadran comes out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! George Dockrell picks up a wicket in his first over and breaks the stand. This is floated up around middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi gets down on one knee and looks for the slog sweep. Shahidi mistimes it badly as the ball goes off the top edge and over short fine leg. Paul Stirling over there runs back and takes an assured catch over his shoulders. Shahidi departs after a sluggish innings.
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b George Dockrell

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Tries to bowl close to the tramline again but this is well wide, left alone by the batter.
A tad bit short and well outside off, Shahidi just taps it towards point.
And again! This is angled across the left-hander and hugging the tramline outside off. This time Hashmatullah Shahidi attempts the reverse sweep but misses.
Dockrell starts from around the wicket and slides it well across the off stump, Shahidi looks to cut it late but misses.
George Dockrell is into the attack now.
Around the top of off, this is cut away towards backward point.
SIX! Easily done! This is a half-volley, angling down the leg side, Usman Ghani uses his wrists to whip it away behind square and all the way for a maximum.

Switches to around the wicket now for the left-hander and bowls it full and wide, taking a bit pace off it as well. Hashmatullah Shahidi just eases it to the right of the point fielder and picks up a single.
Good length, angling onto the pads, Ghani tucks it away towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
FOUR! It's the hard length again but there's some width on offer, Usman Ghani throws his hands at it and slashes it behind point for a cracking boundary.
Hits the length hard and bowls it over off stump, Ghani defends it out with soft hands.
Andy Balbirnie keeps chopping and changing his bowlers as Barry McCarthy is brought back on.
Darts this one and on middle, Usman Ghani tucks it wide of short fine leg for a run. So, 9 runs from the over despite the boundary.
Short and around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi knocks it towards covers for a run.
FOUR! Good shot! This is again tossed up and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi moves across and sweeps it hard towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Tossed up full and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi goes for the reverse sweep but hits it straight to the short third man fielder.
Looped up, outside off and angling away, Hashmatullah Shahidi offers no shot at it.
Starts with a short delivery and on middle, Usman Ghani flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Spin from both ends now as Gareth Delany is brought into the attack.
A bit short again and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi guides it towards cover-point.
Short and on middle, Usman Ghani punches it of his back foot towards long on for another run.
Floated full and on middle and off, Hashmatullah Shahidi eases it towards long on for one.
A bit short and on middle, Usman Ghani goes back and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BOOM! This is flighted full and around off, Usman Ghani makes room and smokes it over extra covers for a biggie.
Tossed up full and on middle, Usman Ghani blocks it down the pitch.
Andy McBrine (1-0-9-0) is back on.
Full and straight, this is pushed away towards mid on for a quick single. At the end of the Powerplay, Afghanistan are 47/1!
Good length, around off, this is dabbed away towards cover-point.
Now a bouncer, bowled around off and almost flying over the head of the batter. Ghani tries to uppercut it but misses.
Around the hips, neatly tucked away 'round the corner for a single.
FOUR! Another edgy boundary. This is dug in short and over off, Ghani looks to step out and force it leg side but gets another outside edge. The ball goes towards third man for yet another boundary.

FOUR! Streaky boundary but Usman Ghani will take it. This is on a length and outside off, Ghani steps out and throws the kitchen sink at it. The ball flies off the top edge and over short third man for a boundary.
Only one over of spin then as Mark Adair is brought back into the attack.
FOUR! Nicely played! Good length, angling across the left-hander, Hashmatullah Shahidi waits for it and cuts it late, behind point for a boundary to get his innings going.
Hashmatullah Shahidi walks out to bat at Number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Barry McCarthy has the last laugh as he sends Rahmanullah Gurbaz packing! On a good length and around middle, Gurbaz walks across the leg stump and tries to force the lofted shot over extra cover. The ball goes off the top edge and lobs up around the mid off region. Harry Tector over there takes a few steps forward and grabs it comfortably. Gurbaz throws his wicket away just when he started to look good.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Around the top of off, Gurbaz stays watchful and just blocks it out.
Back of a length, angling it into the body. Gurbaz tries to play it off the back foot but misses and gets hit on the body.
FOUR! And again! Just short of a length and over middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz takes it on and muscles it over mid-wicket this time for yet another boundary. He looks in full flow now.
FOUR! Shot! Barry McCarthy starts off with a short ball outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz hangs back and just flat-bats it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Barry McCarthy is into the attack now.
Darts this one full and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz works it wide of mid-wicket for one. A good over for Afghanistan as they get 15 runs from it.

FOUR! Rahmanullah Gurbaz is getting into his groove. This is tossed up full and on middle and off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes down for the slog-sweep but gets a thick outside edge over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Quicker and flatter on off, Usman Ghani opens the face of his bat and pushes it towards covers for a quick single.
A bit short and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and forces it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! This time a controlled shot from Gurbaz. A flighted delivery and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz skips down the track and lofts it towards the long off fence for another boundary.
EDGED AND FOUR! This is tossed up and around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans on to block it but gets a thin outside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Andy McBrine comes in as first change.
Fuller one and outside off, Usman Ghani drives it frimly towards covers. The fielder there makes a half stop and the batters get a comfortable two. Only 3 runs from the over.
Length delivery and on off, Usman Ghani stays back and guides it to point.
Goes short again and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes for the pull but mistimes it badly towards mid on for a single.
On a length and around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz dabs it towards bacward point.
A bit short and outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz again tries to slash at it but gets beaten by the pace.
Bowls this full and outside off from 'round the wicket, Rahmanullah Gurbaz tries to carve it away from his crease but misses it completely.
Length ball, outside off, this is driven towards covers for a quick run.
This should have been put away! Short and wide, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes a bit too hard at it and ends up missing it completely.
Ireland continue with the short stuff to Gurbaz and he is getting a bit tied down. This is a quick bumper, over leg stump, Gurbaz looks to take it on but is beaten for pace.
A touch fuller and well outside off, this is slashed away to deep point for just a single.
Just a tad bit short and well outside off, Usman Ghani's eyes light up as he looks to slap it away but misses. Opportunity missed there for the batter.
Adair starts off with a gentle-paced delivery, full and outside off, Gurbaz strokes it away to sweeper cover for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? It will be Mark Adair.

FOUR! Short again from Little but defers in line and pays the price. This is around the hips, Usman Ghani swivels and helps it away into the fine leg fence to get off the mark with a boundary. Five runs come off the first over.
Pitches it a bit further up now and serves it around off, Usman Ghani watchfully defends it out towards cover.
Afghanistan are underway! This is on a length, on middle and leg, Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it straight to square leg and sets off for a quick single.
Another short ball, this time over middle and zipping through. Gurbaz bends his back and sways away from the line of the ball.
A bit of aggression straightaway from Little. This is a bumper, around head height and over leg stump. Gurbaz ducks under it well.
Little starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery, angling across the right-hander. Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes on the back foot and keeps it down on the off side.

Done with the pre-match formalities and we are ready for play! The umpires are out in the middle as the Irish players can be seen in a huddle. The Afghan opening pair of Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Usman Ghani stride out to the middle as well. It will be Josh Little who will get proceedings underway with the ball for Ireland. Let's play...

We are moments away from the start of play. But before that, the two teams line-up for their respective national anthems. It will be Afghanistan's national anthem first, followed by the national anthem of Ireland.

Andy Balbirnie, the Irish captain says that they would have batted first too and the surface looks a good one but will try to restrict the opponents. Says that the performances against South Africa were good but they didn't bowl well later on and will try to improve upon it. Adds that the ground has smaller boundaries and the surface is good and will, try to do good with bat and ball. Ends by saying that they are going with the same team as in the final game against South Africa and will look to do well because it's basically the last series before they head off for the T20 World Cup.

Afghanistan skipper, Mohammad Nabi says that they will bat first. He says that the wicket looks dry and good to bat on. He says that it is a lot different from Asian wickets but they had 2-3 practice sessions to get used to the conditions. He ends by saying that they will try to do well in this series and try to prepare for the World Cup.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Ibrahim Zadran, Usman Ghani, Hashmatullah Shahidi, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Azmatullah Omarzai, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Naveen-ul-Haq and Fazalhaq Farooqi.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Lorcan Tucker (WK), Harry Tector, Gareth Delany, Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy and Josh Little.
TOSS - Afghanistan have won the toss and they will BAT first.

The Irish are back in action! They’ve been playing quite a lot of cricket recently and now they face Afghanistan in a T20I series. Ireland have been quite competitive in their recent games and we expect them to put up another good show against an Afghanistan side that could find it tough in conditions with which they are not familiar too. The visitors though have an upper hand on the home side in this format. This promises to be an exciting contest between the two. Stay tuned for the toss and team sheets.
